<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission scrutiny:</strong> The Supreme Court is considering a PIL demanding an expert committee led by a former CJI to examine the Election Commission’s functioning, amid growing concerns over institutional trust and the SIR exercise.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1NZEdXYUVWSzVrNGJIVmRUY2JhQmZXWnJrM1E1d3ZtZzRCM2FiNnhjN28xMnhTZHl5ektLSHcyWXhQRm5TVlkzakYzNHJ3Vk5LRkNDSlF5QkNfUDQwSjlRRHdkT2lGNDlX?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition protests:</strong> The INDIA bloc has announced plans for a &quot;Mock Parliament&quot; and nationwide protests on October 30 to demand the removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and the withdrawal of the SIR exercise.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary concerns:</strong> Observers and political critics are raising alarms over the declining efficacy of Parliament, citing the frequent suspension of MPs and the rushed passage of legislation as evidence of a diminishing democratic voice.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Voter list controversies:</strong> The Congress party has demanded an impartial probe into voter list errors in Uttar Pradesh and a halt to the SIR exercise, asserting that the Election Commission bears full responsibility for data accuracy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxNWXdvVWRsdnZZR3VuaWRySUlnTWFCM205QUhLSi1iZHFZT1FhYW93UmhwaC11Y3AtdXdueTdrWGNpdC1jbS1HOE5TS2ZuRi03U09ZWnBDR1k1c2REZ29uTDIwd1MtMlZ3dElzUFNHZjgya0FjNnhCNk4wWnl5ZTZjMk4zMHNJZVF5bG1pdS1jd0hfQ2dNSGJGTmhHbEI3cmtCUzAxUEVFQTJoMVNnUVNPNTlBMy1Ba3VMNk8yX3FqWmNMSHE5a0RfU1VGNA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political friction:</strong> The BJP has accused the opposition of manufacturing chaos and undermining constitutional institutions, while internal political maneuvering continues in regions like Jammu and Kashmir and Uttar Pradesh.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
</ul>
